TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BAGUETTE.title: Baguette
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BAGUETTE.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. On turn [blue]3[/blue], lose {EnergyLoss:energyIcons()}.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BROKEN_POCKETWATCH.title: Broken Pocketwatch
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BROKEN_POCKETWATCH.descr: If you play [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] or fewer {CardThreshold:plural:card|cards} during your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BROKEN_POCKETWATCH.flavo: Even broken, it is right twice a day.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_UNHATCHED_EMBER.title: Unhatched Ember
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_UNHATCHED_EMBER.descript: Once per combat: when you die, revive with [blue]1[/blue] HP. You cannot die for the rest of this turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_WILD_HUNT.title: Wild Hunt
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_WILD_HUNT.description: Delay the deaths of other players by one turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_TECH_TEA_SET.title: Tech Tea Set
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_TECH_TEA_SET.description:
At the start of combat, consume [blue]1[/blue] charge and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Whenever you enter a Rest Site, gain [blue]{ChargesGained}[/blue] charges.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_TECH_TEA_SET.flavor: The 67th-generation release of a renowned tea set.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_EGG_WAFFLE.title: Egg Waffle
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_EGG_WAFFLE.description: [gold]Energy[/gold] remaining at the end of combat is carried into the next combat.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_PAELS_GENE_BANK.title: Pael's Gene Bank
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_PAELS_GENE_BANK.descript: At the end of each combat, gain an additional card reward. Its cards are from your deck.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BASE_VEHICLE.title: Mobile Construction Vehicle
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BASE_VEHICLE.description:
Random cards in your card rewards are [gold]Enchanted[/gold]: [purple]Mobile Base[/purple].
Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] fewer cards on your first turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BASE_VEHICLE.flavor: An essential choice for a refined boy.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_PREMIUM_BIG_FRUIT.title: Premium Large Fruit
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_PREMIUM_BIG_FRUIT.descri:
At the start of each turn, [gold]Enchant[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] to [blue]2[/blue] random cards in your Hand: [purple]Sown[/purple].
Upon pickup, become [gold]Cursed[/gold]: [purple]Oral Fibrosis[/purple].
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_PREMIUM_BIG_FRUIT.flavor: Good fruit: satisfyingly chewy and full of flavor.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_SIERPINSKI_SPONGE.title: Sierpinski Sponge
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_SIERPINSKI_SPONGE.descri: Whenever you obtain a [gold]Relic[/gold], obtain a [gold]Wax copy[/gold] of it. Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, your left-most [gold]Wax Relic[/gold] melts away.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_SIERPINSKI_SPONGE.flavor: Infinite surface area. Limited shelf life.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_NINE_YIN_MANUAL.title: Nine Yin Manual
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_NINE_YIN_MANUAL.descript:
Upon pickup, choose up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your deck to remove, then become randomly Cursed [blue]{Curses}[/blue] times.
Whenever you draw a Curse, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], then draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_NINE_YIN_MANUAL.flavor: No one in the Spire can read this tome.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_GOOD_STOPWATCH.title: Good Watch
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_GOOD_STOPWATCH.descripti: At the end of turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue], take an extra turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_GOOD_STOPWATCH.flavor: You have reached perfection; time flows slowly around you.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_MONSTER_ENERGY_DRINK.des: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold] at a Rest Site, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] copies of [gold]Poor Sleep[/gold] to your Deck.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_MONSTER_ENERGY_DRINK.fla: Not suitable for those allergic to caffeine.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_MONSTER_ENERGY_DRINK.add: Add {Cards} copies of [gold]Poor Sleep[/gold] to your Deck.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_MECHANICAL_ARM_BASE.desc: Every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, add a random upgraded [gold]Power[/gold] to your Hand. It can be played for free this turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_MECHANICAL_ARM_BASE.flav: A steady foundation for tireless machinery.
